item.description: ### Fixed - **A running Codex session keeps showing what it's doing.** With Codex hooks installed, the row's tool line (for example "exec: npm test") and its timer could disappear within a second of a tool starting, leaving a plain "Running" for the rest of a long command. - **Codex no longer stays at NEEDS YOU after you answer a subagent in the terminal.** When a Codex subagent asked for permission and you answered in Codex's own prompt, the session could stay marked as waiting on you while the subagent carried on. It now clears as soon as that subagent moves on or stops. - **No more stray Codex rows from the Codex app.** Codex Desktop runs short background threads of its own, and each could appear as an extra idle Codex row, sometimes labelled "/". Perch now leaves them out.
